extName.description: The extension's name, as the browser and the add-on stores show it. Keep "Sidecar" untranslated; the part after the bar may be translated.

extDescription.message: Um assinador Nostr NIP-07 com várias contas e carteira Lightning integrada, na barra lateral do navegador.
extDescription.description: One line under the name in the browser's extension list and the store listings. Keep "NIP-07", "Nostr" and "Lightning" as written.

sidebarTitle.description: Title of the sidebar in Firefox. The product name, not translated.

payPillPayable.description: The corner pill for a Lightning invoice found on a web page. AMOUNT is the number, shown in bold.

payPillInvoicePayable.description: The same pill for an invoice with no amount of its own.

payPillLabel.message: Fatura Lightning de $AMOUNT$ sat para pagar em $SITE$. Abre o Sidecar para a pagar.
payPillLabel.description: Screen-reader label for the pill. SITE is the web page's host.

payPillLabelNoAmount.message: Fatura Lightning para pagar em $SITE$. Abre o Sidecar para a pagar.
payPillLabelNoAmount.description: Screen-reader label for the pill when the invoice has no amount.

dismiss.description: Screen-reader label for the pill's close button.

hide.description: Screen-reader label for the close button on the payment-in-progress pill. Hides the indicator; it does not cancel the payment.

flightSending.description: The corner pill while a payment is going out. AMOUNT in bold.

flightZapping.description: The same pill for an automatic zap.

flightSendingPayment.description: The pill while a payment with no stated amount goes out.

flightZappingPayment.description: The same, for an automatic zap.

flightPaid.description: The pill once the payment has settled. AMOUNT in bold.

cardEyebrow.description: Small heading on the payment card. A REQUEST, not a charge: nothing has been paid yet. Keep that sense.

unitSats.description: The unit under the amount on the payment card (satoshis).

cardNoAmountMemo.message: Uma fatura Lightning. Escolhe o montante no Sidecar.
cardNoAmountMemo.description: Shown on the card for an invoice with no amount of its own.

cardAutoZapOffer.description: Switch on the card that turns on automatic zaps up to MAX.

cardLabel.description: Screen-reader label for the payment card.

cardFoundOn.description: Under the amount: where the invoice was found. SITE in bold.

cardPay.description: The card's pay button. Pressing it asks Sidecar; nothing is sent until approved there.

cardDontShow.description: Switch that stops the card appearing for invoices found on pages.

cardConfirmInSidecar.description: The pay button while Sidecar asks for approval.

cardAwaiting.message: Aprova no Sidecar para enviar. Ainda nada saiu da tua carteira.
cardAwaiting.description: Status under the button while waiting for approval. Must stay clear that nothing has been paid yet.

cardTryAgain.description: The pay button after a payment failed.

cardFailed.description: Shown when a payment fails with no reason given.

cardOtherWallet.description: On the pay card: hands the invoice to whichever Lightning app is registered on this computer instead of paying with Sidecar.

cardOfferEyebrow.message: O Sidecar pode pagar esta fatura
cardOfferEyebrow.description: Heading of the pay card when it is offered on a site not signed in with Sidecar, after the person taps a Lightning link.

cardOfferDontAsk.description: On the offer card: stop offering to pay Lightning links on sites not signed in with Sidecar.

firstOfferEyebrow.description: Heading of the first-time card shown when a Lightning invoice appears on a site not signed in with Sidecar.

firstOfferBody.message: Em qualquer página, não só em sites ligados.
firstOfferBody.description: Body of the first-time card offering to pay invoices on any page.

firstOfferAny.description: First-time card choice: turn on paying invoices on sites not signed in with Sidecar. Confirmed in Sidecar's panel.

firstOfferSignedIn.message: Apenas sites em que tenho sessão iniciada
firstOfferSignedIn.description: First-time card choice: keep Sidecar's pay prompts to sites signed in with Sidecar.

firstOfferConfirm.description: First-time card, after choosing Pay on any page: points to Sidecar's panel.

firstOfferClose.description: First-time card: closes it after Pay on any page was chosen.
